Year 1 — Foundational
  Initiative: Continuous Access Evaluation
  Depends on: MFA everywhere (quick win)
  Changes: session revoked within minutes of a
           risk signal, not at next login

Year 2 — Foundational to Long-Haul
  Initiative: Micro-segmentation of production
  Depends on: CAE + device compliance signals
  Changes: lateral movement requires a new
           access decision at every boundary
